listings.description: Craving rich berry flavour without the sugar spike? Meet the Juzzle Berry Collection a bold, guilt-free iced tea pack designed for your daily routine. Inside every pack, you'll find 6 quick-mix sachets (3 Strawberry and 3 Blueberry) that deliver a refreshing, clean finish in just 10 seconds. listings.description: What flavors come in the box? You get 6 quick-mix sachets in total, split evenly with 3 strawberry and 3 blueberry flavours. Is it high in calories or sugar? Not at all, it is completely sugar-free and low calorie so you can enjoy it without any guilt. How long does it take to make? Just about 10 seconds, you simply tear the sachet, mix it with 180 ml of water, and give it a quick stir. Can I carry it around easily? Yes, the individual sachets are compact enough to toss right into your bag for work or college.

listings.title: Fruity Collection | No Sugar | 90g - Pack of 6 Sachets
listings.description: What tropical flavors are included in the box? You get 6 sachets featuring three exciting combinations: two Mango Peach, two Pineapple Ginger, and two Peach & Passion. Does this contain any sugar? No, it is a completely sugar-free iced tea that delivers rich fruit sweetness with zero sugar and a clean finish. How do I prepare it? Just tear open a sachet, pour it into 180 ml of water, stir, and it's ready in 10 seconds. How does the Pineapple Ginger taste? It provides a bold, spicy tropical kick that stands out from regular fruit drinks
